welcome_default:
👋 Hi {name}! This bot does 3 things: 🎬 anime discovery, 🛡️ group management, 🧰 utilities.

Pick an area below, or tap ☰ for the full command list.
welcome_clone:
👋 Hi {name}! Welcome to {clone_name}.{tagline}

Anime, group tools, and utilities — pick an area below.
download_prompt: Send me a link (YouTube, etc.) and I'll grab the audio or video for you.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
catch.hub.title: Catch hub
catch.hub.description: Choose a category below to explore the Discord catch game.
catch.hub.footer: Use Home to return to Play. This panel expires after 15 minutes.
catch.setup.title: Creature catching setup
catch.setup.description: Configure the server-side spawn loop before enabling creature catching.
catch.setup.footer: Changes are staged in this panel until the setup is saved.
catch.setup.select_channel: Select at least one spawn channel before enabling catching.
catch.setup.text_channel: Select at least one text channel.
catch.encounter.server_only: Encounters are only available in a server channel.
catch.setup.manage_server: Only members with Manage Server can change Catch setup.
catch.setup.enable_channel: Select at least one spawn channel before enabling catching.
catch.claim.error: That creature could not be claimed right now.
catch.claim.fled.title: The creature got away
catch.claim.fled.description: This spawn was already claimed, expired, or fled.
catch.claim.success.title: Catch successful
catch.encounter.footer: Claim it before it runs away · {expires_at}
catch.setup.need_manage_channels: I need **Manage Channels** to create #wild-zone. Give me that permission, or pick spawn channels with the selector above.
catch.setup.wild_zone_failed: I couldn't create #wild-zone. Check my permissions or pick an existing channel with the selector.
catch.setup.test_posted: Test spawn posted in {channel}. It's a real spawn: claiming it gives the creature to whoever catches it.
catch.setup.test_failed: The test spawn could not be posted in {channel}. Check that I can send messages and embeds there.
catch.ui.not_yours: This panel belongs to someone else. Open your own from /catch.
catch.collection.title: Your collection
catch.collection.empty: You haven't caught anything yet. Use **Encounter** or wait for a wild creature to appear.
catch.collection.not_found: That creature isn't in your collection.
catch.collection.error: Your collection couldn't be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
catch.dex.title: Creature Dex
catch.dex.error: The Dex couldn't be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
